sources.articleTitle: Two men dead after glider crashes into Loch Leven
Two men killed after glider crashes into Loch Leven in Scotland

headline: Two Men Die Following Glider Crash At Loch Leven In Scotland
seoTitle: Two Men Die In Loch Leven Glider Crash
metaDescription: Two men were killed after a training flight glider crashed into Loch Leven in Scotland; emergency services recovered their bodies after a morning alarm.
aiSummaryBullets: Two men died after their glider crashed into Loch Leven in Scotland on Friday morning.
The aircraft, identified as a two-seater Perkoz, was on a training flight from the Scottish Gliding Centre.
Police Scotland confirmed that emergency services recovered both bodies from the water after being notified at 11:05.
aiContextParagraph: On the morning of Friday, November 20, 2026, a fatal aviation incident occurred involving a two-seater Perkoz glider in Perth and Kinross, Scotland. The aircraft had departed from the Scottish Gliding Centre located at Portmoak for a scheduled local training flight. Shortly after takeoff, the glider crashed into Loch Leven, a major freshwater body in the region. Emergency responders were alerted to the situation at 11:05 and subsequently initiated a recovery operation. Police Scotland confirmed that both occupants of the glider were deceased upon recovery. The Scottish Gliding Centre acknowledged the incident, stating the aircraft was performing a training exercise at the time of the crash. Authorities have since secured the scene to investigate the circumstances surrounding the accident. No further details regarding the identity of the victims or potential causes of the crash have been disclosed at this time.
whyItIsViral: The incident is receiving moderate attention, being reported by two major national outlets.
